This is a writ petition for quashing of FIR no. 0232/2024 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC, PS Khajuri Khas and other proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. It is submitted that both parties have come to an amicable settlement.
However, respondent no. 2 states that she has not received back her gold jwellery articles.
3. As per the settlement agreement (Mubarat Deed) dated 17.07.2025, the exchange of articles/ornaments shall take place after the quashing proceedings.
However, respondent no. 2 insists that they be returned before the quashing proceedings.
Petitioners have no objection.
They seek short adjournment for the purpose of exchange of the articles/ornaments.
